text:
maya: alert - spikes in mTLS handshake failures in eu-west at ~08:12 UTC, proxies show KMS decrypt AccessDenied.
owen: saw it too, an RBAC prune ran ~08:10.
maya: proxy log snippet (redacted):
```
2026-04-05T08:12:03Z proxy-eu-1 ERROR mTLS: cert unseal failed: kms:Decrypt AccessDenied for key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/efg
    at keystore.Unseal (rotator.go:182)
```
chris_s: audit shows `rbac-prune` removed `keystore.decrypt` from group `svc-proxy-eu` at 08:09.
lee: mitigation options: revert binding, add temporary allow, or failover to central decrypt. Fastest is revert.
oncall: infra-ops approval needed.
infra-bot: emergency revert PR opened by chris_s: https://git.internal/infra/rbac/pull/430
infra-bot: infra-ops approved at 08:14 UTC.
own: binding restored 08:14:40, decrypts success resumed by 08:15:05, handshake errors dropped ~90% by 08:17.
maya: incident mitigated; tagging logs with `inc-1720102468` and exporting CloudTrail.
chris_s: root cause: prune ran without dry-run due to pipeline env flip.
lee: action items: (1) make dry-run default for prune, (2) pre-prune canary that performs kms:Decrypt against synthetic key per region, (3) add RBAC allowlist for keystore/proxy groups, (4) add monitoring rule: if >10% proxies report kms AccessDenied in 2m, page infra and auto-open revert.
own: creating incident: https://pm.internal/incidents/INC-2026-04012 assigned to @chris_s and @lee.
maya: SOC notified for audit bundle.
oncall: closing thread, reopen if we see recurrence.
